title: Lookup Tables
statementMd:
John has $Q$ closed intervals of consecutive $2K$-bit numbers $[l_i, r_i]$ and one 16-bit value $v_i$ for each interval. ($0 \leq i \lt Q$)

John wants to implement a function F that maps $2K$-bit numbers to 16-bit numbers in such a way that inputs from each interval are mapped to that interval's value. In other words: $$F(x) = v_i, \; \textrm{for every } 0 \leq i \lt Q \; \textrm{, and every } x \in [l_i, r_i]$$ The output of F for other inputs is unimportant.

John wants to make his implementation of F fast so he has decided to use lookup tables. A single $2K$-bit lookup table would be too large to fit in memory, so instead John plans to use two K-bit lookup tables, LSBTable and MSBTable. His implementation will look like this: $$ F(x) = \textrm{LSBTable}[\textrm{lowKBits}(x)] \; \& \; \textrm{MSBTable}[\textrm{highKBits}(x)]$$ In other words it returns the "bitwise and" of results of looking up the K least significant bits in LSBTable and the K most significant bits in MSBTable.

John needs your help. Given $K$, $Q$ and $Q$ intervals $[l_i, r_i]$ and values $v_i$, find any two lookup tables which can implement F or report that such tables don't exist.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $K$ and $Q$ ($ 1 \lt = K \lt = 16$, $1 \lt = Q \lt = 2\cdot 10^5$).

Each of the next $Q$ lines contains three integers $l_i$, $r_i$ and $v_i$. ( $0 \leq l_i \leq r_i \lt 2^{2K}$, $0 \leq v_i \lt 2^{16}$).

## Output

On the first line output "possible" (without quotes) if two tables satisfying the conditions exist, or "impossible" (without quotes) if they don't exist.

If a solution exists, in the next $2 \cdot 2^K$ lines your program should output all values of the two lookup tables (LSBTable and MSBTable) it found. When there are multiple pairs of tables satisfying the conditions, your program may output any such pair.

On lines $1 + i$ output $\textrm{LSBTable}[i]$. ($0 \leq i \lt 2^K$, $0 \leq \textrm{LSBTable}[i] \lt 2^{16}$).

On lines $1 + 2^K + i$ output $\textrm{MSBTable}[i]$. ($0 \leq i \lt 2^K$, $0 \leq \textrm{MSBTable}[i] \lt 2^{16}$).

## Note

A closed interval $[a, b]$ includes both a and b.

In the first sample, tables $\textrm{LSBTable} = [1,3]$ and $\textrm{MSBTable} = [1,3]$ satisfy the conditions: $F[0] = \textrm{LSBTable}[0] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[0] = 1 \& 1 = 1$, $F[1] = \textrm{LSBTable}[1] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[0] = 3 \& 1 = 1$, $F[2] = \textrm{LSBTable}[0] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[1] = 1 \& 3 = 1$, $F[3] = \textrm{LSBTable}[1] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[1] = 3 \& 3 = 3$.

In the second sample, tables $\textrm{LSBTable} = [3,3,2,2]$ and $\textrm{MSBTable} = [0,3,0,1]$ satisfy all the conditions.

In the third sample there are no two lookup tables which can satisfy the conditions.
statementZhMd:
John 有 $Q$ 个由连续的 $2K$ 位数组成的闭区间 $[l_i, r_i]$，并且每个区间对应一个 16 位值 $v_i$。（$0 \leq i \lt Q$）

John 希望实现一个函数 F，将 $2K$ 位数映射为 16 位数，使得每个区间中的输入都映射到该区间对应的值。换句话说：$$F(x) = v_i, \; \textrm{for every } 0 \leq i \lt Q \; \textrm{, and every } x \in [l_i, r_i]$$ 对于其他输入，F 的输出无关紧要。

John 希望让 F 的实现尽可能快，因此决定使用查找表。单个 $2K$ 位查找表太大，无法放入内存，所以 John 计划使用两个 K 位查找表：LSBTable 和 MSBTable。他的实现将如下所示：$$ F(x) = \textrm{LSBTable}[\textrm{lowKBits}(x)] \; \& \; \textrm{MSBTable}[\textrm{highKBits}(x)]$$ 换句话说，它返回在 LSBTable 中查找最低 K 位、在 MSBTable 中查找最高 K 位所得结果的“按位与”。

John 需要你的帮助。给定 $K$、$Q$ 以及 $Q$ 个区间 $[l_i, r_i]$ 和对应的值 $v_i$，请找出任意两个能够实现 F 的查找表，或者报告不存在这样的查找表。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $K$ 和 $Q$（$ 1 \lt = K \lt = 16$，$1 \lt = Q \lt = 2\cdot 10^5$）。

接下来的 $Q$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 $l_i$、$r_i$ 和 $v_i$。（$ 0 \leq l_i \leq r_i \lt 2^{2K}$，$0 \leq v_i \lt 2^{16}$）

## 输出格式

如果存在满足条件的两个查找表，第一行输出 `possible`（不含引号）；否则输出 `impossible`（不含引号）。

如果存在解，接下来的 $2 \cdot 2^K$ 行中应输出程序找到的两个查找表（LSBTable 和 MSBTable）的所有值。当存在多组满足条件的查找表时，可以输出其中任意一组。

在第 $1 + i$ 行输出 $\textrm{LSBTable}[i]$。（$0 \leq i \lt 2^K$，$0 \leq \textrm{LSBTable}[i] \lt 2^{16}$）

在第 $1 + 2^K + i$ 行输出 $\textrm{MSBTable}[i]$。（$0 \leq i \lt 2^K$，$0 \leq \textrm{MSBTable}[i] \lt 2^{16}$）

## 说明

闭区间 $[a, b]$ 包含 a 和 b。

在第一个样例中，查找表 $\textrm{LSBTable} = [1,3]$ 和 $\textrm{MSBTable} = [1,3]$ 满足条件：$F[0] = \textrm{LSBTable}[0] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[0] = 1 \& 1 = 1$，$F[1] = \textrm{LSBTable}[1] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[0] = 3 \& 1 = 1$，$F[2] = \textrm{LSBTable}[0] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[1] = 1 \& 3 = 1$，$F[3] = \textrm{LSBTable}[1] \& \textrm{MSBTable}[1] = 3 \& 3 = 3$。

在第二个样例中，查找表 $\textrm{LSBTable} = [3,3,2,2]$ 和 $\textrm{MSBTable} = [0,3,0,1]$ 满足所有条件。

在第三个样例中，不存在能够满足条件的两个查找表。
